1	# Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025
     2	
     3	## What Is This Benchmark?
     4	
     5	Aider is an AI pair-programming tool that runs in the terminal. To evaluate which large language models (LLMs) are best at autonomous code editing, Aider maintains a **polyglot coding leaderboard**. The benchmark tests each model on **225 challenging Exercism coding exercises** spanning **six programming languages**: C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust. Models must follow instructions and produce correct code edits without any human intervention.
     6	
     7	The primary metric is **percent correct** — the share of exercises where the model's code passes all tests after two attempts. Secondary metrics include total cost per benchmark run, correct edit format rate (how reliably the model follows the required diff format), and qualitative indicators like syntax errors and exhausted context windows.
     8	
     9	## Top 15 Models — Ranked by Accuracy
    10	
    11	| Rank | Model | Percent Correct | Cost | Edit Format | Correct Format % |
    12	|------|-------|----------------|------|-------------|------------------|
    13	| 1 | GPT-5 (high) | 88.0% | $29.08 | diff | 91.6% |
    14	| 2 | GPT-5 (medium) | 86.7% | $17.69 | diff | 88.4% |
    15	| 3 | Claude 4.0 Opus | 85.3% | $22.14 | diff-fenced | 97.3% |
    16	| 4 | Claude 4.0 Sonnet | 84.0% | $9.47 | diff-fenced | 96.9% |
    17	| 5 | Gemini 2.5 Pro | 82.7% | $4.92 | diff-fenced | 95.1% |
    18	| 6 | o3 (high) | 82.2% | $18.35 | diff | 90.7% |
    19	| 7 | GPT-5 (low) | 81.3% | $8.12 | diff | 85.8% |
    20	| 8 | DeepSeek R1-0528 | 80.4% | $3.88 | diff-fenced | 93.2% |
    21	| 9 | Claude 3.7 Sonnet | 79.6% | $7.81 | diff-fenced | 96.0% |
    22	| 10 | o3 (medium) | 78.7% | $10.22 | diff | 89.3% |
    23	| 11 | Gemini 2.5 Flash | 76.4% | $1.28 | diff-fenced | 93.8% |
    24	| 12 | GPT-4.1 | 74.7% | $5.60 | diff | 88.0% |
    25	| 13 | DeepSeek V3-0324 | 72.9% | $1.95 | diff-fenced | 91.5% |
    26	| 14 | Claude 3.5 Sonnet | 72.0% | $6.33 | diff-fenced | 95.5% |
    27	| 15 | o4-mini (high) | 71.1% | $4.47 | diff | 87.2% |
    28	
    29	## Cost vs. Accuracy Highlights
    30	
    31	Cost varies enormously across models. GPT-5 (high) delivers the best accuracy at **88.0%** but costs **$29.08** per full benchmark run. Meanwhile, **Gemini 2.5 Flash** achieves a respectable **76.4%** for just **$1.28** — roughly 23× cheaper. DeepSeek R1-0528 offers a compelling middle ground at **80.4% for $3.88**, making it one of the best value options on the board.
    32	
    33	For teams optimizing cost-efficiency, models in the $1–$5 range (Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V3, Gemini 2.5 Pro) deliver over 72% accuracy, which may be sufficient for many real-world coding tasks.
    34	
    35	## Edit Format Compliance
    36	
    37	Reliably following the edit format is critical for automated pipelines. Models using the **diff-fenced** format tend to have higher compliance rates (93–97%) compared to those using plain **diff** (85–92%). Claude models consistently lead in format compliance, with Claude 4.0 Opus reaching **97.3%** well-formed edits.
    38	
    39	## Key Takeaways
    40	
    41	- **GPT-5 (high) leads the board** at 88.0% accuracy but at a premium cost of ~$29.
    42	- **Anthropic Claude 4.0 models** offer the best balance of accuracy and format reliability.
    43	- **DeepSeek and Gemini models** provide strong performance at a fraction of the cost.
    44	- The benchmark covers **6 languages and 225 exercises**, making it one of the most comprehensive polyglot code-editing evaluations available.
    45	- Edit format choice matters: diff-fenced yields more reliable automated edits than plain diff.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate the Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025 poster.
Portrait format, dark background, data-forward modern tech aesthetic.
"""

import os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
OUTPUT_PATH = '/app/output/final_poster.png'
DPI = 150
WIDTH_IN = 24
HEIGHT_IN = 36

# Dark theme colors
BG_COLOR = '#0B1120'        # Deep navy/near-black
BG_PANEL = '#111827'        # Slightly lighter panel bg
BORDER_COLOR = '#1E293B'    # Panel borders
TEXT_PRIMARY = '#F8FAFC'    # Main text
TEXT_SECONDARY = '#94A3B8'  # Muted text
ACCENT_BLUE = '#38BDF8'     # Electric blue
ACCENT_TEAL = '#2DD4BF'     # Teal
ACCENT_AMBER = '#FBBF24'    # Warm amber
ACCENT_RED = '#F87171'      # Soft red
GRID_COLOR = '#1E293B'

# Model family colors
FAMILY_COLORS = {
    'OpenAI': '#38BDF8',      # Blue
    'Anthropic': '#F472B6',   # Pink
    'Google': '#34D399',      # Green
    'DeepSeek': '#A78BFA',    # Purple
}

# Data
MODELS = [
    {'rank': 1, 'name': 'GPT-5 (high)', 'score': 88.0, 'cost': 29.08, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 91.6, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 2, 'name': 'GPT-5 (medium)', 'score': 86.7, 'cost': 17.69, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 88.4, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 3, 'name': 'Claude 4.0 Opus', 'score': 85.3, 'cost': 22.14, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 97.3, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 4, 'name': 'Claude 4.0 Sonnet', 'score': 84.0, 'cost': 9.47, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 96.9, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 5, 'name': 'Gemini 2.5 Pro', 'score': 82.7, 'cost': 4.92, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 95.1, 'family': 'Google'},
    {'rank': 6, 'name': 'o3 (high)', 'score': 82.2, 'cost': 18.35, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 90.7, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 7, 'name': 'GPT-5 (low)', 'score': 81.3, 'cost': 8.12, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 85.8, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 8, 'name': 'DeepSeek R1-0528', 'score': 80.4, 'cost': 3.88, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 93.2, 'family': 'DeepSeek'},
    {'rank': 9, 'name': 'Claude 3.7 Sonnet', 'score': 79.6, 'cost': 7.81, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 96.0, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 10, 'name': 'o3 (medium)', 'score': 78.7, 'cost': 10.22, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 89.3, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 11, 'name': 'Gemini 2.5 Flash', 'score': 76.4, 'cost': 1.28, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 93.8, 'family': 'Google'},
    {'rank': 12, 'name': 'GPT-4.1', 'score': 74.7, 'cost': 5.60, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 88.0, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 13, 'name': 'DeepSeek V3-0324', 'score': 72.9, 'cost': 1.95, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 91.5, 'family': 'DeepSeek'},
    {'rank': 14, 'name': 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet', 'score': 72.0, 'cost': 6.33, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 95.5, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 15, 'name': 'o4-mini (high)', 'score': 71.1, 'cost': 4.47, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 87.2, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
]

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
def add_rounded_rect(ax, x, y, width, height, radius, facecolor, edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, alpha=1.0, zorder=0):
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), width, height,
                          boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                          facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=edgecolor,
                          linewidth=linewidth, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder,
                          transform=ax.transData)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

def draw_text(ax, x, y, text, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='left', va='center', weight='normal', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5):
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=fontsize, color=color, ha=ha, va=va, weight=weight, fontfamily=fontfamily, zorder=zorder)

# ============================================================
# SETUP FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(WIDTH_IN, HEIGHT_IN), dpi=DPI)
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 150)
ax.axis('off')
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

# ============================================================
# HEADER / HERO SECTION
# ============================================================
# Title block
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 138, 94, 10, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 50, 144.5, 'Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025', fontsize=28, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center', weight='bold')
draw_text(ax, 50, 141, 'Autonomous code-editing accuracy across 225 Exercism exercises in 6 languages', fontsize=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='center', va='center')

# Hero metrics
metric_boxes = [
    ('88.0%', 'Top Score', 'GPT-5 (high)'),
    ('6', 'Languages', 'C++, Go, Java, JS, Python, Rust'),
    ('225', 'Exercises', 'Exercism coding challenges'),
    ('$29.08', 'Highest Cost', 'GPT-5 (high)'),
]
box_w = 22
box_h = 8
start_x = 3
spacing = 1.5
for i, (val, label, ctx) in enumerate(metric_boxes):
    x = start_x + i * (box_w + spacing)
    y = 127
    add_rounded_rect(ax, x, y, box_w, box_h, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
    draw_text(ax, x + box_w/2, y + box_h - 2.2, val, fontsize=22, color=ACCENT_BLUE, ha='center', va='center', weight='bold')
    draw_text(ax, x + box_w/2, y + box_h/2 - 0.5, label, fontsize=13, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center', weight='bold')
    draw_text(ax, x + box_w/2, y + 1.5, ctx, fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# ABOUT THE BENCHMARK
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 113, 94, 12, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 122.5, 'About the Benchmark', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')
about_text = (
    "Aider is an AI pair-programming tool that evaluates LLMs on autonomous code editing. "
    "The polyglot benchmark tests each model on 225 challenging Exercism coding exercises spanning six languages: "
    "C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust. Models must follow instructions and produce correct code edits "
    "without human intervention. The primary metric is percent correct — exercises passing all tests after two attempts."
)
draw_text(ax, 5, 118.5, about_text, fontsize=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='left', va='top')

# ============================================================
# TOP MODELS RANKING (centerpiece)
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 58, 94, 53, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 108.5, 'Top Models by Accuracy', fontsize=18, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Table header
header_y = 105.5
col_x = [5, 14, 52, 68, 82, 94]
headers = ['#', 'Model', 'Accuracy', 'Cost', 'Format', 'Format %']
weights = ['bold', 'bold', 'bold', 'bold', 'bold', 'bold']
for x, h, w in zip(col_x, headers, weights):
    align = 'left' if x < 50 else 'center'
    draw_text(ax, x, header_y, h, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha=align, va='center', weight=w)

# Divider line
ax.plot([4, 96], [104.2, 104.2], color=BORDER_COLOR, linewidth=1, zorder=2)

# Table rows
row_h = 3.1
start_y = 102.5
for i, m in enumerate(MODELS):
    y = start_y - i * row_h
    color = FAMILY_COLORS.get(m['family'], TEXT_PRIMARY)
    # Rank
    rank_color = ACCENT_AMBER if m['rank'] <= 3 else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw_text(ax, 5, y, str(m['rank']), fontsize=12, color=rank_color, ha='left', va='center', weight='bold')
    # Model name
    draw_text(ax, 14, y, m['name'], fontsize=12, color=color, ha='left', va='center', weight='bold')
    # Accuracy bar
    bar_max_w = 12
    bar_w = (m['score'] / 100) * bar_max_w
    add_rounded_rect(ax, 52, y - 0.7, bar_w, 1.4, 0.3, ACCENT_BLUE, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    draw_text(ax, 52 + bar_max_w + 1, y, f"{m['score']:.1f}%", fontsize=11, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='left', va='center', weight='bold')
    # Cost
    draw_text(ax, 70, y, f"${m['cost']:.2f}", fontsize=11, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center')
    # Format
    fmt_color = ACCENT_TEAL if m['format'] == 'diff-fenced' else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw_text(ax, 83, y, m['format'], fontsize=10, color=fmt_color, ha='center', va='center')
    # Format %
    draw_text(ax, 94, y, f"{m['format_pct']:.1f}%", fontsize=11, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center')

# Legend for families
legend_y = 57.5
legend_items = list(FAMILY_COLORS.items())
legend_x = 5
for fam, col in legend_items:
    add_rounded_rect(ax, legend_x, legend_y - 0.6, 1.2, 1.2, 0.3, col, zorder=3)
    draw_text(ax, legend_x + 2, legend_y, fam, fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='left', va='center')
    legend_x += 12

# ============================================================
# COST VS ACCURACY SCATTER
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 28, 46, 28, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 53.5, 'Cost vs. Accuracy Trade-Off', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Mini scatter axes
scatter_ax = fig.add_axes([0.06, 0.145, 0.42, 0.16])  # [left, bottom, width, height]
scatter_ax.set_facecolor(BG_PANEL)
for spine in scatter_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER_COLOR)
    spine.set_linewidth(1)
scatter_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=9)
scatter_ax.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

scores = [m['score'] for m in MODELS]
costs = [m['cost'] for m in MODELS]
colors = [FAMILY_COLORS.get(m['family'], TEXT_PRIMARY) for m in MODELS]
sizes = [120 if m['rank'] <= 3 else 70 for m in MODELS]

scatter_ax.scatter(scores, costs, c=colors, s=sizes, alpha=0.85, edgecolors=BG_COLOR, linewidths=1.5, zorder=5)
scatter_ax.set_xlabel('Accuracy (%)', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=10)
scatter_ax.set_ylabel('Cost per run ($)', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=10)
scatter_ax.set_xlim(68, 92)
scatter_ax.set_ylim(0, 32)

# Annotate a few key points
annotations = [
    (1, 'GPT-5 (high)', 'right'),
    (3, 'Claude 4.0 Opus', 'left'),
    (5, 'Gemini 2.5 Pro', 'right'),
    (8, 'DeepSeek R1', 'left'),
    (11, 'Gemini 2.5 Flash', 'right'),
]
for rank, label, align in annotations:
    m = MODELS[rank-1]
    offset = (-8, 8) if align == 'left' else (8, 8)
    scatter_ax.annotate(label, (m['score'], m['cost']), textcoords="offset points",
                        xytext=offset, fontsize=7, color=TEXT_PRIMARY,
                        ha=align, va='bottom',
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, lw=0.5))

# ============================================================
# EDIT FORMAT COMPLIANCE
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 51, 28, 46, 28, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 53, 53.5, 'Edit Format Compliance', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Mini bar chart axes
fmt_ax = fig.add_axes([0.545, 0.145, 0.42, 0.16])
fmt_ax.set_facecolor(BG_PANEL)
for spine in fmt_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER_COLOR)
    spine.set_linewidth(1)
fmt_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=9)
fmt_ax.grid(True, axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

# Top 10 models by format compliance
fmt_models = sorted(MODELS, key=lambda m: m['format_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]
names = [m['name'] for m in fmt_models]
vals = [m['format_pct'] for m in fmt_models]
bar_colors = [ACCENT_TEAL if m['format'] == 'diff-fenced' else ACCENT_BLUE for m in fmt_models]

y_pos = np.arange(len(names))
bars = fmt_ax.barh(y_pos, vals, color=bar_colors, height=0.6, edgecolor=BG_COLOR, linewidth=1)
fmt_ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
fmt_ax.set_yticklabels(names, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=8)
fmt_ax.invert_yaxis()
fmt_ax.set_xlim(80, 100)
fmt_ax.set_xticks([80, 85, 90, 95, 100])
fmt_ax.set_xlabel('Correct Format %', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=10)

for bar, val in zip(bars, vals):
    fmt_ax.text(val + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}%',
                va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Legend
fmt_ax.scatter([], [], c=ACCENT_TEAL, s=50, label='diff-fenced')
fmt_ax.scatter([], [], c=ACCENT_BLUE, s=50, label='diff')
fmt_ax.legend(loc='lower right', facecolor=BG_PANEL, edgecolor=BORDER_COLOR,
              labelcolor=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=9)

# ============================================================
# KEY TAKEAWAYS
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 5, 94, 21, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 23.5, 'Key Takeaways', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

takeaways = [
    ("GPT-5 leads at 88.0%", "but costs $29.08 per run — premium accuracy comes at a premium price."),
    ("Anthropic Claude 4.0 models", "offer the best balance of accuracy and format reliability (96–97% compliance)."),
    ("DeepSeek & Gemini deliver strong value", "— DeepSeek R1 hits 80.4% for $3.88; Gemini 2.5 Flash reaches 76.4% for just $1.28."),
    ("Format choice matters", "— diff-fenced models average 94% compliance vs. 88% for plain diff, critical for automation."),
]

for i, (bold_part, rest) in enumerate(takeaways):
    y = 20 - i * 4.5
    draw_text(ax, 6, y, '▸', fontsize=14, color=ACCENT_AMBER, ha='left', va='top')
    draw_text(ax, 8, y, bold_part, fontsize=12, color=ACCENT_BLUE, ha='left', va='top', weight='bold')
    draw_text(ax, 8 + len(bold_part)*0.28, y, ' ' + rest, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='left', va='top')

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
draw_text(ax, 50, 2, 'Data: Aider Polyglot Benchmark 2025 | 225 Exercism exercises across 6 languages | Models tested without human intervention',
          fontsize=10, color='#64748B', ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_PATH, dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG_COLOR, edgecolor='none', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.2)
plt.close()

# Verify output
img = Image.open(OUTPUT_PATH)
print(f"Saved poster: {OUTPUT_PATH}")
print(f"Dimensions: {img.size[0]} x {img.size[1]} px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate the Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025 poster.
Portrait format, dark background, data-forward modern tech aesthetic.
"""

import os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
OUTPUT_PATH = '/app/output/final_poster.png'
DPI = 150
WIDTH_IN = 24
HEIGHT_IN = 36

# Dark theme colors
BG_COLOR = '#0B1120'        # Deep navy/near-black
BG_PANEL = '#111827'        # Slightly lighter panel bg
BORDER_COLOR = '#1E293B'    # Panel borders
TEXT_PRIMARY = '#F8FAFC'    # Main text
TEXT_SECONDARY = '#94A3B8'  # Muted text
ACCENT_BLUE = '#38BDF8'     # Electric blue
ACCENT_TEAL = '#2DD4BF'     # Teal
ACCENT_AMBER = '#FBBF24'    # Warm amber
ACCENT_RED = '#F87171'      # Soft red
GRID_COLOR = '#1E293B'

# Model family colors
FAMILY_COLORS = {
    'OpenAI': '#38BDF8',      # Blue
    'Anthropic': '#F472B6',   # Pink
    'Google': '#34D399',      # Green
    'DeepSeek': '#A78BFA',    # Purple
}

# Data
MODELS = [
    {'rank': 1, 'name': 'GPT-5 (high)', 'score': 88.0, 'cost': 29.08, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 91.6, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 2, 'name': 'GPT-5 (medium)', 'score': 86.7, 'cost': 17.69, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 88.4, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 3, 'name': 'Claude 4.0 Opus', 'score': 85.3, 'cost': 22.14, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 97.3, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 4, 'name': 'Claude 4.0 Sonnet', 'score': 84.0, 'cost': 9.47, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 96.9, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 5, 'name': 'Gemini 2.5 Pro', 'score': 82.7, 'cost': 4.92, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 95.1, 'family': 'Google'},
    {'rank': 6, 'name': 'o3 (high)', 'score': 82.2, 'cost': 18.35, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 90.7, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 7, 'name': 'GPT-5 (low)', 'score': 81.3, 'cost': 8.12, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 85.8, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 8, 'name': 'DeepSeek R1-0528', 'score': 80.4, 'cost': 3.88, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 93.2, 'family': 'DeepSeek'},
    {'rank': 9, 'name': 'Claude 3.7 Sonnet', 'score': 79.6, 'cost': 7.81, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 96.0, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 10, 'name': 'o3 (medium)', 'score': 78.7, 'cost': 10.22, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 89.3, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 11, 'name': 'Gemini 2.5 Flash', 'score': 76.4, 'cost': 1.28, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 93.8, 'family': 'Google'},
    {'rank': 12, 'name': 'GPT-4.1', 'score': 74.7, 'cost': 5.60, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 88.0, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
    {'rank': 13, 'name': 'DeepSeek V3-0324', 'score': 72.9, 'cost': 1.95, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 91.5, 'family': 'DeepSeek'},
    {'rank': 14, 'name': 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet', 'score': 72.0, 'cost': 6.33, 'format': 'diff-fenced', 'format_pct': 95.5, 'family': 'Anthropic'},
    {'rank': 15, 'name': 'o4-mini (high)', 'score': 71.1, 'cost': 4.47, 'format': 'diff', 'format_pct': 87.2, 'family': 'OpenAI'},
]

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
def add_rounded_rect(ax, x, y, width, height, radius, facecolor, edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, alpha=1.0, zorder=0):
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), width, height,
                          boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                          facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=edgecolor,
                          linewidth=linewidth, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder,
                          transform=ax.transData)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

def draw_text(ax, x, y, text, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='left', va='center', weight='normal', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5):
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=fontsize, color=color, ha=ha, va=va, weight=weight, fontfamily=fontfamily, zorder=zorder)

# ============================================================
# SETUP FIGURE
# ============================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(WIDTH_IN, HEIGHT_IN), dpi=DPI)
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 150)
ax.axis('off')
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

# ============================================================
# HEADER / HERO SECTION
# ============================================================
# Title block
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 138, 94, 10, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 50, 144.5, 'Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025', fontsize=28, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center', weight='bold')
draw_text(ax, 50, 141, 'Autonomous code-editing accuracy across 225 Exercism exercises in 6 languages', fontsize=14, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='center', va='center')

# Hero metrics
metric_boxes = [
    ('88.0%', 'Top Score', 'GPT-5 (high)'),
    ('6', 'Languages', 'C++, Go, Java, JS, Python, Rust'),
    ('225', 'Exercises', 'Exercism coding challenges'),
    ('$29.08', 'Highest Cost', 'GPT-5 (high)'),
]
box_w = 22
box_h = 8
start_x = 3
spacing = 1.5
for i, (val, label, ctx) in enumerate(metric_boxes):
    x = start_x + i * (box_w + spacing)
    y = 127
    add_rounded_rect(ax, x, y, box_w, box_h, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
    draw_text(ax, x + box_w/2, y + box_h - 2.2, val, fontsize=22, color=ACCENT_BLUE, ha='center', va='center', weight='bold')
    draw_text(ax, x + box_w/2, y + box_h/2 - 0.5, label, fontsize=13, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center', weight='bold')
    draw_text(ax, x + box_w/2, y + 1.5, ctx, fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# ABOUT THE BENCHMARK
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 113, 94, 12, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 122.5, 'About the Benchmark', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')
about_text = (
    "Aider is an AI pair-programming tool that evaluates LLMs on autonomous code editing. "
    "The polyglot benchmark tests each model on 225 challenging Exercism coding exercises spanning six languages: "
    "C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust. Models must follow instructions and produce correct code edits "
    "without human intervention. The primary metric is percent correct — exercises passing all tests after two attempts."
)
draw_text(ax, 5, 118.5, about_text, fontsize=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='left', va='top')

# ============================================================
# TOP MODELS RANKING (centerpiece)
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 58, 94, 53, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 108.5, 'Top Models by Accuracy', fontsize=18, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Table header
header_y = 105.5
col_x = [5, 14, 52, 68, 82, 94]
headers = ['#', 'Model', 'Accuracy', 'Cost', 'Format', 'Format %']
weights = ['bold', 'bold', 'bold', 'bold', 'bold', 'bold']
for x, h, w in zip(col_x, headers, weights):
    align = 'left' if x < 50 else 'center'
    draw_text(ax, x, header_y, h, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha=align, va='center', weight=w)

# Divider line
ax.plot([4, 96], [104.2, 104.2], color=BORDER_COLOR, linewidth=1, zorder=2)

# Table rows
row_h = 3.1
start_y = 102.5
for i, m in enumerate(MODELS):
    y = start_y - i * row_h
    color = FAMILY_COLORS.get(m['family'], TEXT_PRIMARY)
    # Rank
    rank_color = ACCENT_AMBER if m['rank'] <= 3 else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw_text(ax, 5, y, str(m['rank']), fontsize=12, color=rank_color, ha='left', va='center', weight='bold')
    # Model name
    draw_text(ax, 14, y, m['name'], fontsize=12, color=color, ha='left', va='center', weight='bold')
    # Accuracy bar
    bar_max_w = 12
    bar_w = (m['score'] / 100) * bar_max_w
    add_rounded_rect(ax, 52, y - 0.7, bar_w, 1.4, 0.3, ACCENT_BLUE, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    draw_text(ax, 52 + bar_max_w + 1, y, f"{m['score']:.1f}%", fontsize=11, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='left', va='center', weight='bold')
    # Cost
    draw_text(ax, 70, y, f"${m['cost']:.2f}", fontsize=11, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center')
    # Format
    fmt_color = ACCENT_TEAL if m['format'] == 'diff-fenced' else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw_text(ax, 83, y, m['format'], fontsize=10, color=fmt_color, ha='center', va='center')
    # Format %
    draw_text(ax, 94, y, f"{m['format_pct']:.1f}%", fontsize=11, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center')

# Legend for families
legend_y = 57.5
legend_items = list(FAMILY_COLORS.items())
legend_x = 5
for fam, col in legend_items:
    add_rounded_rect(ax, legend_x, legend_y - 0.6, 1.2, 1.2, 0.3, col, zorder=3)
    draw_text(ax, legend_x + 2, legend_y, fam, fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='left', va='center')
    legend_x += 12

# ============================================================
# COST VS ACCURACY SCATTER
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 28, 46, 28, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 53.5, 'Cost vs. Accuracy Trade-Off', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Mini scatter axes
scatter_ax = fig.add_axes([0.06, 0.145, 0.42, 0.16])  # [left, bottom, width, height]
scatter_ax.set_facecolor(BG_PANEL)
for spine in scatter_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER_COLOR)
    spine.set_linewidth(1)
scatter_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=9)
scatter_ax.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

scores = [m['score'] for m in MODELS]
costs = [m['cost'] for m in MODELS]
colors = [FAMILY_COLORS.get(m['family'], TEXT_PRIMARY) for m in MODELS]
sizes = [120 if m['rank'] <= 3 else 70 for m in MODELS]

scatter_ax.scatter(scores, costs, c=colors, s=sizes, alpha=0.85, edgecolors=BG_COLOR, linewidths=1.5, zorder=5)
scatter_ax.set_xlabel('Accuracy (%)', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=10)
scatter_ax.set_ylabel('Cost per run (USD)', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=10)
scatter_ax.set_xlim(68, 92)
scatter_ax.set_ylim(0, 32)

# Annotate a few key points
annotations = [
    (1, 'GPT-5 (high)', 'right'),
    (3, 'Claude 4.0 Opus', 'left'),
    (5, 'Gemini 2.5 Pro', 'right'),
    (8, 'DeepSeek R1', 'left'),
    (11, 'Gemini 2.5 Flash', 'right'),
]
for rank, label, align in annotations:
    m = MODELS[rank-1]
    offset = (-8, 8) if align == 'left' else (8, 8)
    scatter_ax.annotate(label, (m['score'], m['cost']), textcoords="offset points",
                        xytext=offset, fontsize=7, color=TEXT_PRIMARY,
                        ha=align, va='bottom',
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, lw=0.5))

# ============================================================
# EDIT FORMAT COMPLIANCE
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 51, 28, 46, 28, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 53, 53.5, 'Edit Format Compliance', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Mini bar chart axes
fmt_ax = fig.add_axes([0.545, 0.145, 0.42, 0.16])
fmt_ax.set_facecolor(BG_PANEL)
for spine in fmt_ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER_COLOR)
    spine.set_linewidth(1)
fmt_ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_SECONDARY, labelsize=9)
fmt_ax.grid(True, axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

# Top 10 models by format compliance
fmt_models = sorted(MODELS, key=lambda m: m['format_pct'], reverse=True)[:10]
names = [m['name'] for m in fmt_models]
vals = [m['format_pct'] for m in fmt_models]
bar_colors = [ACCENT_TEAL if m['format'] == 'diff-fenced' else ACCENT_BLUE for m in fmt_models]

y_pos = np.arange(len(names))
bars = fmt_ax.barh(y_pos, vals, color=bar_colors, height=0.6, edgecolor=BG_COLOR, linewidth=1)
fmt_ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
fmt_ax.set_yticklabels(names, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=8)
fmt_ax.invert_yaxis()
fmt_ax.set_xlim(80, 100)
fmt_ax.set_xticks([80, 85, 90, 95, 100])
fmt_ax.set_xlabel('Correct Format %', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=10)

for bar, val in zip(bars, vals):
    fmt_ax.text(val + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}%',
                va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

# Legend
fmt_ax.scatter([], [], c=ACCENT_TEAL, s=50, label='diff-fenced')
fmt_ax.scatter([], [], c=ACCENT_BLUE, s=50, label='diff')
fmt_ax.legend(loc='lower right', facecolor=BG_PANEL, edgecolor=BORDER_COLOR,
              labelcolor=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontsize=9)

# ============================================================
# KEY TAKEAWAYS
# ============================================================
add_rounded_rect(ax, 3, 5, 94, 21, 0.5, BG_PANEL, BORDER_COLOR, 1, zorder=1)
draw_text(ax, 5, 23.5, 'Key Takeaways', fontsize=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, weight='bold')

takeaways = [
    ("GPT-5 leads at 88.0%", "but costs $29.08 per run — premium accuracy comes at a premium price."),
    ("Anthropic Claude 4.0 models", "offer the best balance of accuracy and format reliability (96–97% compliance)."),
    ("DeepSeek & Gemini deliver strong value", "— DeepSeek R1 hits 80.4% for USD 3.88; Gemini 2.5 Flash reaches 76.4% for just USD 1.28."),
    ("Format choice matters", "— diff-fenced models average 94% compliance vs. 88% for plain diff, critical for automation."),
]

for i, (bold_part, rest) in enumerate(takeaways):
    y = 20 - i * 4.5
    draw_text(ax, 6, y, '▸', fontsize=14, color=ACCENT_AMBER, ha='left', va='top')
    draw_text(ax, 8, y, bold_part, fontsize=12, color=ACCENT_BLUE, ha='left', va='top', weight='bold')
    draw_text(ax, 8 + len(bold_part)*0.28, y, ' ' + rest, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, ha='left', va='top')

# ============================================================
# FOOTER
# ============================================================
draw_text(ax, 50, 2, 'Data: Aider Polyglot Benchmark 2025 | 225 Exercism exercises across 6 languages | Models tested without human intervention',
          fontsize=10, color='#64748B', ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_PATH, dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG_COLOR, edgecolor='none', bbox_inches=None, pad_inches=0)
plt.close()

# Verify output
img = Image.open(OUTPUT_PATH)
print(f"Saved poster: {OUTPUT_PATH}")
print(f"Dimensions: {img.size[0]} x {img.size[1]} px")
